NATIONAL ENVIRONMENTAL ACT, NO. 47 OF 1980

REGULATIONS made by the President under Paragraph (o) of Subsection (2) of Section 32 of the National EnvironmentalAct, No. 47 of 1980 read with paragraph (i) of Section 10 of that Act and Section 51 of the Nineteenth Amendment to theConstitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENAPresident.Colombo,04th November, 2019.Regulations
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Control of Bill Boards and Hoardings (Visual Pollution) RegulationsNo. 01 of 2019

2. Any bill board, hoarding, structure or device used for the purpose of displaying an advertisement shall be inconformity with these regulations and shall not be erected obstructing the view of natural environment, landscape, visualamenity and safety of persons.
3. A person shall not erect any bill board, hoarding, structure or device for the purpose of displaying andadvertisement -
(a)without a permit issued for such purpose by the relevant Authority specified in the Schedule hereto,subject to the payment of a fee as may be charged by such Authority ; and

(b)except in accordance with the guidelines relating to the prevention of obstruction of the view of naturalenvironment, landscape, visual amenity and safety of persons as may be issued from time to time bysuch relevant Authority.
4. The relevant Authority shall issue the permit for a period not more than twelve (12) months and may berenewed annually subject to the payment of a renewal fee as may be charged by such Authority.

5. Where any bill board, hoarding, structure or device used for the purpose of displaying an advertisement isdisplayed for more than twelve (12) months without the permit being renewed under regulation 4, the relevant Authorityshall inform the holder of permit to remove such bill board, hoarding, structure or device used for the purpose of displayingan advertisement from such place.

6. Where a bill board, hoarding, structure or device used for the purpose of displaying an advertisement is notremoved as informed by the relevant Authority under regulation 5, such Authority shall remove it and recover the cost ofsuch removal from the holder of the permit.
7. The relevant authority shall have the power to remove any bill board, hoarding, structure or device used for thepurpose of displaying an advertisement -
(a)to ensure safety and security of persons ;
(b)to prevent the obstruction of the view of natural environment, landscape, visual amenity ; and
(c)to comply with any statutory requirement.
8. In these Regulations -

“advertisement” includes any word, letter, sign, signboard, banner, balloon and poster illuminated or non-illuminated or digitally displayed (static or moving) and posted on land, buildings, walls, hoardings,frames, kiosks, posts, tree guard, gantries, mobile vehicles, passage, shelters or temporary arches.
(Regulations 3)
